headline: AlphaSense launched SuperAnalyst, an AI agent for finance and strategy teams that carries out research and analysis tasks and keeps updating its work as conditions change.
score_reason: Official launch of a notable enterprise finance agent, but all capability claims come from the company's own press release; score kept.
importance_line: Investors and corporate analysts get an agent that can keep monitoring the assumptions behind a decision, but the claims of speed and accuracy are AlphaSense's own and the quotes come from customers it chose.
summary: AlphaSense, a market-intelligence company used by banks and large firms, announced on 6 Oct 2026 that SuperAnalyst, an always-on AI agent, can plan and run multi-step research, write and run code, and produce outputs such as investment memos and financial models that refresh on their own. The company says it keeps monitoring the assumptions behind a thesis and updates the work without a new prompt; these are the company's claims, supported in the release by quotes from two customer investment professionals.
notes: Company press release read at alpha-sense.com; no independent testing reported.
